worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.summary: Charge up, leap and slam into the target with an electric strike that knocks it back. Missing the target hurts the user.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.descript: The charged drop deals %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, Electric match-up and crits are settled on the hit.
Rise %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, dive at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift.
Up to %1$s blocks of reach with a %2$s block discharge radius; a miss costs %3$s of the user's maximum health.
Charge level %1$s: each level is x1.07 slam power, a faster dive and +0.01 self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +3 ticks of cooldown and 0.2 blocks less reach.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and knockback to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.0: Deliver an Electric ranged strike with a charged drop
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.1: Dump a built charge to shove a target off you
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.2: Wear down a hard target with ranged Electric damage
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.preferen: Charge levels built before the leap: each level is x1.07 slam power, a faster dive and +0.01 self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +3 ticks of cooldown and 0.2 blocks less reach. Level 0 is a quick light drop - farther, faster and lighter, but it does not shock hard.
Only drop on a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Farther than the other crash kicks, for opening pressure.
Below this health ratio the user stops using Supercell Slam (a miss's self-hurt can be lethal). Higher is more cautious; lower takes more risk.
